_note: Source is Fakhruddin Properties' own dedicated Treppan Tower project page (developer domain only; no portal, agency or aggregator used, no form filled, no brochure downloaded, no stock imagery). Every image below was opened at its own URL in an isolated browser tab and viewed before being described. HOW I SEPARATED IT FROM THE SIBLINGS: I pulled the full image manifest of the Treppan Tower page and of all three sibling pages (/projects/treppan-vision, /projects/treppan-serenique, /projects/treppan-living-prive) and compared asset URLs. There is ZERO overlap of project imagery - the only assets shared across pages are the generic Dubai landmark thumbnails used in the drive-times strip, a generic lifestyle portrait (images/young-woman.webp) and a shared master-map file. All eleven project renders on the Treppan Tower page are unique to that page. Content corroborates this: Treppan Serenique and Treppan Living Prive are Dubai Islands waterfront schemes, and Treppan Vision is a visibly different building with its own render set (ELEVATION_*, CAM_* files); every exterior below is an inland low-rise/parkland setting consistent with JVT, with no sea or island frontage, and the tower massing matches the page's stated G+5P+27F+R. EXCLUDED: (a) images/treppan-serenique-map.webp - the site reuses the Serenique-named master map on the Treppan Tower page, so it is a sibling-named asset and cannot be presented as Treppan Tower; (b) images/young-woman.webp - a generic lifestyle portrait reused on all four project pages, i.e. stock-type filler; (c) all amenity SVG icons, the project logo and the Dubai landmark thumbnails, which are not pictures of the building. CAUTION ON FILENAMES: one of the strongest exteriors is named Serenie_View - the name points at the Serenique sibling, but that exact asset does NOT appear on the Serenique page, and the scene is inland JVT parkland, not Dubai Islands waterfront, so it belongs to Treppan Tower. Two hero files (Cover_top_27208db394 and Cover_top_bb18900d7e) are visually identical duplicates; only one is listed. These are CGI renders, not photographs - I found no construction or completed photography of Treppan Tower on the developer's own domain.

This is the single best full-building wide exterior on the page.
